goal: Search for member M1001, open their record, open a new Savings sub-account for them with nickname "Emergency Fund" and an initial deposit of 250, then confirm and complete opening the account.

decision.thought: Starting the task. Need to fill the search input with member ID M1001 and click search.

action.locatorDescription: Search input field for member ID or name
action.riskRationale: Filling a search field has no side effects.

locatorDescription: Search input field for member ID or name

decision.thought: The search input already has M1001 filled in. Next step is to click the Search button to search for the member.

action.riskRationale: Clicking search just performs a lookup, no side effects.

checkpoint.description: Member M1001 record should appear after search

decision.thought: Search results show member M1001 Alice Nguyen. Next step is to open their record by clicking View.

action.riskRationale: Viewing a member record is a read-only navigation action.

checkpoint.description: Member detail page shows Alice Nguyen's name

decision.thought: Member M1001's record is open. Next step is to click "Open Sub-Account" to start creating a new Savings sub-account.

action.riskRationale: Navigating to the open sub-account form does not make any changes yet.

checkpoint.description: The sub-account creation form should appear with fields like nickname and deposit.

decision.thought: Savings is already selected by default. Next, fill in the nickname field with "Emergency Fund".

action.riskRationale: Filling a text field has no lasting side effect until form submission.

checkpoint.description: Nickname field shows the entered text

decision.thought: Nickname is already filled with "Emergency Fund" and account type is Savings. Next need to fill the initial deposit field with 250.

action.riskRationale: Filling a text field with a deposit amount is non-destructive and reversible before submission.

checkpoint.description: The deposit field should show 250 as its value

decision.thought: Fields are filled correctly: account type is Savings, nickname is "Emergency Fund", deposit is 250. Next step is to click Review to proceed to confirmation.

action.riskRationale: Clicking Review just navigates to a confirmation/review step, no irreversible change yet.

checkpoint.description: A confirmation review screen should appear showing the sub-account details before final submission.

decision.thought: The confirmation page shows correct details: Member Alice Nguyen (M1001), Type savings, Nickname Emergency Fund, Initial deposit $250.00. Now I need to click Confirm and Open Account to complete the action. This is a risky/irreversible action as stated on the page, but it matches the goal exactly.

action.riskRationale: This action is irreversible and creates a new sub-account with a real deposit, as explicitly stated on the page.

checkpoint.description: Page should show confirmation that the sub-account was successfully created

decision.thought: The page confirms that the Savings sub-account was successfully opened with account number SA0001 and a balance of $250.00, matching the requested initial deposit. This completes the goal.
